consumer: An offline combat-log analysis script that reads each monster's exported current-HP integer and asks 'what is this monster's raw current HP right now?'
scope: Per-monster raw authoritative current-HP integer for each nearby monster, the ground-truth world value with no display formatting or predicate derivation
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities(monsters) writes mon.get_hp() and mon.get_hp_max() straight from the engine getters into the exported JSON
divergence: A monster whose HP bar the GUI would render as a coarse/quantized health descriptor (e.g. 'bleeding badly') rather than the exact integer: a display-derived value would diverge from the raw get_hp() the script needs, but the raw getter reports the true integer
